verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Segment Engage lets marketers build Audiences from tracking events, traits, and computed traits and sync them to destinations, which implies a no-code, behavior/trait-based approach (segment-docs-9, -32, -38, -53). However, no evidence explicitly describes a visual drag-and-drop builder UI or an estimated-audience-size preview before activation. missing for 10: explicit mention of visual builder interface, 'no SQL required' claim, and audience size estimation feature.
